messages.author: 02952d2e7d70e316
messages.subject: Can multiple users use shinyapp at the same time on free version?
parts:
I made a Shinyapp and deployed in shinyapps.io. But even when one Shinyapp session in one browser is closed, all other session on other users browsers stops. 

Could anyone let me know if this can be solved with paid version or is this due to some bug in my program?

Thanks!

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Can multiple users use shinyapp at the same time on free version?
parts: One thing to keep in mind when working with shiny is that is any data loaded on per session basis will allocate memory when each user connects. By default applications running are limited to 1GB of memory. If your application works fine with 1 user, but fails when the second user connects, it could be you are running out of memory. If this is happening, a message should be in your application logs.
